title: Evaluating model generalizability for suicide attempt risk prediction: traditional machine vs deep learning.
summary: Cross-site validation found limited transfer of an established suicide-risk model, with defined tradeoffs in an observed EHR outcome.
ai_technology: The study replicated an existing learned risk score and compared tabular ML and deep models across clinical encounter settings.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Cross-site validation found limited transfer of an established suicide-risk model, with defined tradeoffs in an observed EHR outcome.
evidence.unknown: More than 750,000 retrospective visits and observed 90-day outcomes in an external health system. No intervention efficacy was established.
evidence.ai_role: The study replicated an existing learned risk score and compared tabular ML and deep models across clinical encounter settings.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
